company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: We use the profile to calculate how well tenders fit your company (0–100). The more complete the profile, the better the results.

company.emptyMember: An organization admin can create the profile.

company.scopeHint: These fields directly affect the match score.

company.websiteError: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
company.resourcesHint: Equipment, staff and financial capacity – useful when checking the conditions for participation.

company.scoreDisclaimer: The match score shows how well a tender fits the profile. It is not a probability of winning.
company.privacy: Only members of your organization can see the profile. It is never shared with other users.
company.referencesHint: Completed contracts. A reference in the same sector (CPV division) raises the score.
company.refCpvHint: One code describing the subject of the reference.
company.certificationsHint: E.g. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, licences and permits.
